selection_reason: CSW-09 completed_verified in PR #443. APW-02, APW-03, APW-04 and APW-05 satisfy APW-06 dependencies; the owner-approved interleave selects APW-06 before APM-05.
objective: Define Shell, Navigation, Notifications, Visibility and Spoiler UX so users can always identify current Personal/Campaign/Session context, applicable contextual role/authority, waiting work and information classification while asynchronous/persistent workflows remain understandable, privacy-safe, accessible and recoverable.
completion_gate: Users can always identify where they are, which contextual authority applies, what is waiting, and whether information is Personal, Campaign-local, reusable, hidden or merely spoiler-filtered, across desktop/mobile/accessibility/offline/recovery states without protected-information leakage.
required_design_questions: What global shell/context switcher makes Personal, Campaign and Session context unmistakable without treating Player/GM as account identity?
How are contextual role/authority labels presented clearly but without exposing raw permission internals?
How do Player waiting, GM things-need-you, Campaign Activity, creator Command Center and Workshop attention states coexist without duplicate/conflicting queues?
What notification taxonomy and prioritization distinguishes decision-required, result-ready, informational, stale/recovery and creator-advisory events?
How do deep links preserve return context and recover after permission/version/connectivity changes?
What visual/content treatments distinguish Personal, Campaign-local, reusable, Sandbox, hidden and spoiler-filtered material?
How does optional Spoiler Shield reduce accidental exposure without being mistaken for a security boundary?
How are search/filter/result counts/notifications/badges authorization-filtered before aggregation to prevent hidden-information leakage?
How do notification preferences and quieting avoid coercive engagement, repeated nagging and creator-pressure patterns?
How do CSW-09 Command Center surfaces integrate into the shell without becoming a parallel global navigation authority?
What keyboard/touch/screen-reader/reduced-motion/mobile patterns provide equivalent context, notification and visibility behavior?
What deterministic acceptance cases cover context switches, role changes, stale deep links, hidden counts, offline/reconnect and spoiler-shield bypass attempts?
next_action: Execute APW-06 as a bounded design/governance tranche defining shell/context navigation, contextual-role presentation, pending/waiting surfaces, notification taxonomy, deep links, visibility/spoiler UX, authorization-safe search/badges and accessibility/mobile/offline/recovery acceptance.
